SELECT clubowner_key, club_name, club_logo, club_region, club_status, TO_CHAR(club_created, 'YYYY-MM-DD') club_created, club_content FROM Club
ORDER BY clubowner_key DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH FIRST #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT clubowner_key, club_name, club_logo, club_region, club_status, TO_CHAR(club_created, 'YYYY-MM-DD') club_created, club_content FROM Club WHERE clubowner_key = #{clubowner_key}

SELECT p.clubjoin_num, position, height, weight, join_date, p.status, m.userName, m.userLevel, m.memberIdx, c.club_logo FROM Player p JOIN clubJoin cj ON p.clubJoin_num = cj.clubJoin_num JOIN Club c ON c.clubOwner_key = p.clubOwner_key JOIN Member1 m ON cj.memberIdx = m.memberIdx WHERE p.clubowner_key = #{clubowner_key} ORDER BY p.clubjoin_num
